units.zh: 邸珍 宋遊道 盧斐 畢義雲
units.en: Di Zhen, Song Youdao, Lu Fei, and Bi Yiyun
units.literal: Di Zhen, Song Youdao, Lu Fei, Bi Yiyun

units.zh: 夫人之性靈，稟受或異，剛柔區別，緩急相形，未有深察是非，莫不肆其情欲。
units.en: Human nature differs at birth; rigidity and softness, urgency and ease shape one another—few truly weigh right and wrong, and nearly all indulge feeling and desire.
units.literal: Man's nature and spirit, what he receives at birth, may differ; rigidity and softness are distinct, urgency and ease take shape against each other—few deeply examine right and wrong, and none fail to give full play to feeling and desire.

units.zh: 至於詳觀水火、更佩韋弦者鮮矣。
units.en: Those who watch fire and water closely and wear the girdle of restraint are rare indeed.
units.literal: As for those who closely observe fire and water and again wear the girdle-weights of caution, they are rare.

units.zh: 獄吏為患，其所從來久矣。
units.en: Prison clerks as a scourge—their origin is ancient.
units.literal: Prison clerks as a scourge—their origin is of long standing.

units.zh: 自魏途不競，網漏寰區，高祖懲其寬怠，頗亦威嚴馭物，使內外羣官，咸知禁網。
units.en: When Wei lost hold of the realm the law's net gaped wide; Gao Huan punished lax rule and governed with stern majesty until every official, within and without, knew the prohibitory mesh.
units.literal: From the time Wei lost the contest for the realm, the net leaked across the world; Gao Huan punished its lax slackness and also used stern majesty to master things, so that inner and outer officials all knew the prohibitory mesh.

units.zh: 今錄邸珍等以存《酷吏》，懲示勸勵云。
units.en: Here Di Zhen and the rest are recorded under Cruel Officials, as warning and encouragement.
units.literal: Now Di Zhen and the rest are recorded to preserve Cruel Officials, as warning and encouragement.

units.zh: 邸珍，字寶安，本中山上曲陽人也。
units.en: Di Zhen, style Bao'an, was originally from Shangquyang in Zhongshan.
units.literal: Di Zhen, style Bao'an, was originally a man of Shangquyang in Zhongshan.

units.zh: 從高祖起義，拜為長史。
units.en: He followed Gao Huan in raising the righteous army and was made chief clerk.
units.literal: He followed Gao Huan in raising the righteous army and was appointed chief clerk.

units.zh: 性嚴暴，求取無厭。
units.en: Stern and violent by nature, he sought and took without satiety.
units.literal: His nature was stern and violent; in seeking and taking he knew no satiety.

units.zh: 後兼尚書右僕射、大行臺，節度諸軍事。
units.en: He later also served as Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Grand Commissioner of the Traveling Court, directing military affairs.
units.literal: Later he also held concurrent posts as Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Grand Commissioner with the Traveling Court, directing all military affairs.

units.zh: 珍御下殘酷，衆士離心，為民所害。
units.en: Zhen ruled subordinates with cruel severity; his officers lost heart and the people killed him.
units.literal: Zhen ruled subordinates with cruel severity; the host of officers lost heart, and the people killed him.

units.zh: 後贈定州刺史。
units.en: He was later posthumously made inspector of Ding province.
units.literal: Later he was posthumously given Ding province.

units.zh: 宋遊道，廣平人，其先自燉煌徙焉。
units.en: Song Youdao was from Guangping; his ancestors had moved there from Dunhuang.
units.literal: Song Youdao was a man of Guangping; his ancestors had moved there from Dunhuang.

units.zh: 父季預，為渤海太守。
units.en: His father Jiyu was prefect of Bohai.
units.literal: His father Jiyu was prefect of Bohai.

units.zh: 遊道弱冠隨父在郡，父亡，吏人贈遺，一無所受。
units.en: As a youth Youdao followed his father in the commandery; when his father died he accepted no gift from clerks or people.
units.literal: In his weak-capping years Youdao followed his father in the commandery; when his father died, gifts from clerks and people he accepted not one.

units.zh: 事母以孝聞。
units.en: He served his mother and was known for filial piety.
units.literal: He served his mother and was known for filial piety.

units.zh: 與叔父別居，叔父為奴誣以逆，遊道誘令返，雪而殺之。
units.en: Living apart from an uncle whose slave falsely accused him of treason, Youdao lured the slave back, cleared the charge, and killed him.
units.literal: He lived apart from his uncle; the uncle had a slave falsely accuse him of treason—Youdao lured the slave to return, cleared the charge, and killed him.

units.zh: 魏廣陽王深北伐，請為鎧曹，及為定州刺史，又以為府佐。
units.en: When the Wei Prince of Guangyang marched north, Youdao was requested as armor-cases staff; as inspector of Ding he again made Youdao a staff officer.
units.literal: When Wei Prince of Guangyang campaigned north, Youdao was requested as armor-cases staff; when he became inspector of Ding province, Youdao was again made staff officer of his office.

units.zh: 廣陽王為葛榮所殺，元徽誣其降賊，收錄妻子，遊道為訴得釋，與廣陽王子迎喪返葬。
units.en: The Prince of Guangyang was killed by Ge Rong; Yuan Hui slandered him for surrendering to bandits and seized his family—Youdao pleaded and freed them and with the prince's son escorted the coffin home for burial.
units.literal: The Prince of Guangyang was killed by Ge Rong; Yuan Hui slandered him as having surrendered to the bandits and seized his wife and children—Youdao pleaded and won their release, and with the prince's son escorted the coffin back for burial.

units.zh: 中尉酈善長嘉其氣節，引為殿中侍御史，臺中語曰：「見賊能討宋遊道。」
units.en: Commandant Li Shanchang admired his spirit and made him palace attendant censor; within the Terrace they said: "See a bandit and strike— that is Song Youdao."
units.literal: Commandant Li Shanchang admired his integrity and spirit and brought him in as palace attendant censor; within the Terrace they said: "To see a bandit and be able to attack him—that is Song Youdao."

units.zh: 孝莊卽位，除左中兵郎中，為尚書令臨淮王彧譴責，遊道乃執版長揖曰：「下官謝王瞋，不謝王理。」
units.en: When Emperor Xiaozhuang took the throne, Youdao became Left Central Army Bureau gentleman; censured by Director Yuan Ye, Prince of Linhuai, Youdao held his board and bowed: "I thank your anger, my lord, not your reasoning."
units.literal: When Emperor Xiaozhuang took the throne, Youdao was made Left Central Army Bureau gentleman; censured by Director of the Masters of Writing Prince of Huaiyang Yuan Ye, Youdao held his board and made a long bow, saying: "Your servant thanks the prince's anger, not the prince's reason."

units.zh: 卽日詣闕上書曰：「徐州刺史元孚頻有表云：『偽梁廣發士卒，來圖彭城，乞增羽林二千。』
units.en: That day he memorialized the throne: "Xuzhou inspector Yuan Fu has repeatedly written that 'false Liang is raising troops against Pengcheng; I beg two thousand more guardsmen.
units.literal: That same day he went to the palace and submitted a memorial: "Xuzhou inspector Yuan Fu has repeatedly memorialized that 'the false Liang is broadly raising troops to take Pengcheng; I beg an added two thousand guardsmen.

units.zh: 以孚宗室重臣，告請應實，所以量奏給武官千人。
units.en: Fu is a weighty clansman; his plea should be genuine, so I measured and memorialized a grant of a thousand military officers.
units.literal: Fu is a weighty minister of the imperial clan; his plea should be real, so I measured and memorialized to grant a thousand military officers.

units.zh: 孚今代下，以路阻自防，遂納在防羽林八百人，辭云：『疆境無事，乞將還家。』
units.en: Fu now leaves his post; citing blocked roads he keeps the men for self-defense, yet takes in eight hundred guardsmen on defense, pleading the borders are quiet and begging to send them home.
units.literal: Fu now leaves his post; citing blocked roads he keeps them for self-defense, yet takes in the eight hundred guardsmen left on defense, pleading that 'the borders are quiet and I beg to send them home.'

units.zh: 臣忝局司，深知不可。
units.en: I serve this bureau and know this cannot stand.
units.literal: Your servant is charged with this bureau and knows deeply this cannot be.

units.zh: 尚書令臨淮王彧卽孚之兄子，遣省事謝遠三日之中八度逼迫，云宜依判許。
units.en: Director Yuan Ye, Prince of Linhuai, is Fu's nephew; within three days his clerk Xie Yuan pressed eight times for approval by precedent.
units.literal: Director of the Masters of Writing Prince of Huaiyang Yuan Ye is Fu's brother's son; within three days his clerk Xie Yuan pressed eight times that it should be allowed by precedent.

units.zh: 臣不敢附下罔上，孤負聖明。
units.en: I dared not attach below and deceive above, betraying Your Majesty's clarity.
units.literal: Your servant dared not attach below and deceive above, betraying the sage clarity.

units.zh: 但孚身在任，乞師相繼，及其代下，便請放還，進退為身，無憂國之意。
units.en: Yet Fu, in office, begged troops in succession; once replaced he at once asked release—acting for himself, not for the state.
units.literal: Yet Fu, while in office, begged troops in succession; when he left his post he at once asked release—advancing and retreating for himself, with no thought for the state.

units.zh: 所請不合，其罪下科。
units.en: The request does not fit; his crime is of the lower grade.
units.literal: The request does not fit; his crime is of the lower grade.

units.zh: 或乃召臣於尚書都堂云：『卿一小郎，憂國之心，豈厚於我？』
units.en: Ye then summoned me to the Masters of Writing hall: 'You petty gentleman—is your care for the state thicker than mine?'
units.literal: Or they even summoned your servant to the Masters of Writing main hall and said: 'You, a petty gentleman—can care for the state in your heart be thicker than mine?'

units.zh: 醜罵溢口，不顧朝章，右僕射臣世隆、吏部郎中臣薛琡已下百餘人並皆聞見。
units.en: Ugly abuse overflowed their mouths, heedless of court law; Right Vice Director Shilong, Bureau gentleman Xue Chu, and more than a hundred others heard and saw.
units.literal: Ugly abuse overflowed their mouths, heedless of court regulations; Right Vice Director Chen Shilong, Bureau gentleman Xue Ju, and more than a hundred below all heard and saw.

units.zh: 臣實獻直言，云：『忠臣奉國，事在其心，亦復何簡貴賤。
units.en: I offered straight words: 'Loyal ministers serve the state in the heart—what matter base or noble?'
units.literal: Your servant truly offered straight words: 'Loyal ministers serve the state—the matter is in the heart; what does it matter whether one is base or noble?

units.zh: 比自北海入洛，王不能致身死難，方清宮以迎暴賊。
units.en: Since you entered Luoyang from Beihai you could not die in the crisis, yet cleared the palace to welcome violent rebels.
units.literal: Since you entered Luoyang from Beihai you could not die in the difficulty, yet cleared the palace to welcome violent rebels.

units.zh: 鄭先護立義廣州，王復建旗往討。
units.en: Zheng Xianhu raised righteousness in Guangzhou and you again raised banners to attack him.
units.literal: Zheng Xianhu raised righteousness in Guangzhou and you again raised banners to attack him.

units.zh: 趨惡如流，伐善何速。
units.en: You rush to evil like a stream and fell the good—how swift!
units.literal: You rush to evil like a stream, yet fell the good—how swift!

units.zh: 今得冠冕百僚，乃欲為私害政。』
units.en: Now crowned above the hundred officials, you wish to harm government for private ends.'
units.literal: Now crowned above the hundred officials, you yet wish to harm the government for private ends.'

units.zh: 為臣此言，彧賜怒更甚。
units.en: For these words Ye's anger grew worse.
units.literal: For these words of your servant, Ye's gift of anger grew still worse.

units.zh: 臣旣不佞，干犯貴臣，乞解郎中。」
units.en: Unworthy, I have offended a noble minister; I beg relief from bureau gentleman."
units.literal: Your servant is unworthy and has offended a noble minister; I beg to be relieved of the bureau gentleman post."

units.zh: 帝召見遊道嘉勞之。
units.en: The emperor summoned Youdao, praised and comforted him.
units.literal: The emperor summoned and received Youdao, praising and comforting him.

units.zh: 彧亦奏言：「臣忝冠百僚，遂使一郎攘袂高聲，肆言頓挫，乞解尚書令。」
units.en: Ye also memorialized: "I crown the hundred officials, yet one gentleman rolls up his sleeves and speaks loudly to blunt me; I beg relief from Director of the Masters of Writing."
units.literal: Ye also memorialized: "Your servant crowns the hundred officials, yet a single gentleman rolls up his sleeves and speaks loudly, freely speaking to blunt and humiliate; I beg to be relieved of Director of the Masters of Writing."

units.zh: 帝乃下勑聽解臺郎。
units.en: The emperor issued an edict allowing relief of the Terrace gentleman.
units.literal: The emperor then issued an edict allowing relief of the Terrace gentleman.

units.zh: 後除司州中從事。
units.en: He was later made Central Army staff officer of Si province.
units.literal: Later he was made Central Army staff officer of Si province.

units.zh: 時將還鄴，會霖雨，行旅擁於河橋。
units.en: When about to return to Ye, rain piled travelers at the Yellow River bridge.
units.literal: When about to return to Ye, continuous rain piled travelers at the Yellow River bridge.

units.zh: 遊道於幕下朝夕宴歌，行者曰：「何時節，作此聲也，固大癡。」
units.en: Youdao feasted and sang under the awning morning and evening; travelers said: "What season is this for such song—you are a great fool."
units.literal: Youdao morning and evening feasted and sang under the awning; travelers said: "What season is this to make such sounds—you are truly a great fool."

units.zh: 遊道應曰：「何時節而不作此聲也？
units.en: Youdao answered: "What season when one should not sing? You too are a great fool.
units.literal: Youdao answered: "What season is there when one should not make such sounds—you too are a great fool.

units.zh: 亦大癡。」
units.en: Also a great fool."
units.literal: Also a great fool."

units.zh: 後神武自太原來朝，見之曰：「此人宋遊道耶？
units.en: When Gao Huan came from Taiyuan to court he said: "Is this Song Youdao?
units.literal: Later Gao Huan came from Taiyuan to court and on seeing him said: "Is this man Song Youdao?

units.zh: 常聞其名，今日始識其面。」
units.en: I have often heard the name; today I first see his face."
units.literal: I have often heard the name; today I first know his face."

units.zh: 遷遊道別駕。
units.en: Youdao was transferred to vice governor.
units.literal: Youdao was transferred to vice governor.

units.zh: 後日，神武之司州，饗朝士，舉觴屬遊道曰：「飲高歡手中酒者大丈夫，卿之為人，合飲此酒。」
units.en: Days later at Si province Gao Huan feasted court gentlemen, raised his cup to Youdao: "He who drinks Gao Huan's wine is a great man; you fit this cup."
units.literal: Some days later, when Gao Huan was in Si province feasting court gentlemen, he raised his cup and turned to Youdao: "He who drinks wine from Gao Huan's hand is a great man; your person fits drinking this wine."

units.zh: 及還晉陽，百官辭於紫陽。
units.en: Returning to Jinyang, officials took leave at Ziyang.
units.literal: On returning to Jinyang, the hundred officials took leave at Ziyang.

units.zh: 神武執遊道手曰：「甚知朝貴中有憎忌卿者，但用心，莫懷畏慮，當使卿位與之相似。」
units.en: Gao Huan took his hand: "I know nobles hate you; use your heart, fear nothing—I shall make your rank like theirs."
units.literal: Gao Huan took Youdao's hand and said: "I know well that among court nobles some hate and envy you; only use your heart, do not harbor fear—I shall make your rank resemble theirs."

units.zh: 於是啟以遊道為中尉。
units.en: He memorialized to make Youdao commandant.
units.literal: Thereupon he memorialized to make Youdao commandant.

units.zh: 文襄執請，乃以吏部郎中崔暹為御史中尉，以遊道為尚書左丞。
units.en: Gao Cheng pressed the request; Cui Xian became censor-in-chief and Youdao Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: Gao Cheng pressed the request; thus Cui Xian was made censor-in-chief and Youdao Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 文襄謂暹遊道曰：「卿一人處南臺，一人處北省，當使天下肅然。」
units.en: Gao Cheng told them: "One holds the Southern Terrace, one the Northern Bureau—make the realm stand in awe."
units.literal: Gao Cheng told Xian and Youdao: "One of you holds the Southern Terrace, one the Northern Bureau—you should make the realm stand in awe."

units.zh: 遊道入省，劾太師咸陽王坦、太保孫騰、司徒高隆之、司空侯景、錄尚書元弼、尚書令司馬子如官貸金銀，催徵酬價，雖非指事贓賄，終是不避權豪。
units.en: Entering office, Youdao impeached Grand Tutor Tan, Prince of Xianyang, Grand Guardian Sun Teng, Minister of Education Gao Longzhi, Minister of Works Hou Jing, Director Yuan Bi, Director Sima Ziru and others for official loans of gold and silver—though not direct bribery, he did not spare the powerful.
units.literal: Youdao entered the province and impeached Grand Tutor Prince of Xianyang Wang Tan, Grand Guardian Sun Teng, Minister of Works Gao Longzhi, Minister Hou Jing, Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Bi, Director Sima Ziru and others for official loans of gold and silver, pressing for repayment; though not pointed bribery, in the end he did not avoid the powerful.

units.zh: 又奏駁尚書違失數百條，省中豪吏王儒之徒並鞭斥之。
units.en: He memorialized hundreds of Masters of Writing failures; powerful clerks Wang Ru and others were flogged and driven off.
units.literal: He also memorialized and rejected several hundred failures of the Masters of Writing; powerful clerks Wang Ru and the rest were all flogged and driven off.

units.zh: 始依故事，於尚收省立門名，以記出入早晚，令僕已下皆側目。
units.en: By precedent a gate register recorded comings and goings at the Masters of Writing; from servants down all looked askance.
units.literal: At first according to precedent, at the Masters of Writing reception a gate name was set to record coming and going morning and evening; from servants downward all looked askance.

units.zh: 魏安平王坐事亡，章武二王及諸王妃、太妃是其近親者皆被徵責。
units.en: When the Prince of Anping perished, Zhangwu's two princes and related consorts and grand consorts were all summoned to account.
units.literal: When Prince of Anping Wang sat in a matter and perished, Zhangwu's two princes and the various princes' consorts and grand consorts who were his close kin were all summoned to account.

units.zh: 都官郎中畢義雲主其事，有奏而禁，有不奏輒禁者。
units.en: Bureau gentleman Bi Yiyun directed the matter—memorial or no, he forbade.
units.literal: Bureau gentleman Bi Yiyun directed the matter; where there was a memorial he forbade, where there was none he still forbade.

units.zh: 遊道判下廷尉科罪，高隆之不同，於是反誣遊道厲色挫辱己，遂枉考羣令史證成之，與僕射襄城王旭、尚書鄭述祖等上言曰：「飾偽亂真，國法所必去；
units.en: Youdao sent the case to the Court of Justice; Gao Longzhi disagreed and slandered Youdao for stern insults, falsely examining clerks to prove it; with Vice Director Wang Xu of Xiangcheng, Director Zheng Suzu and others he memorialized: "Adorning falsehood and confusing truth—state law must remove it;
units.literal: Youdao judged and sent down to the Court of Justice for punishment; Gao Longzhi disagreed; thereupon in reverse he slandered Youdao for stern color and insulting himself, and falsely examined group clerks to prove it, and with Vice Director Prince of Xiangcheng Wang Xu, Director Zheng Suzu and others memorialized: "Adorning falsehood and confusing truth—what state law must remove;

units.zh: 附下罔上，王政所不容。
units.en: Winning over subordinates while deceiving superiors—royal governance cannot tolerate it.
units.literal: Winning over subordinates while deceiving superiors—what royal governance cannot tolerate.

units.zh: 謹案尚書左丞宋遊道名望本闕，功績何紀。
units.en: We find Left Vice Director Song Youdao—fame deficient, merit unrecorded:
units.literal: We respectfully find Left Vice Director Song Youdao—his fame and standing originally deficient, his merit and record—what tally?

units.zh: 屬永安之始，朝士亡散，乏人之際，叨竊臺郎。
units.en: at Yong'an's start, when court gentlemen fled, he stole a Terrace post in dearth of men.
units.literal: At the beginning of Yong'an, court gentlemen scattered in flight; in a time of dearth of men he stole the Terrace gentleman post.

units.zh: 躁行諂言，肆其姦詐，罕識名義，不顧典文，人鄙其心，衆畏其口。
units.en: Restless and fawning, full of treachery; heedless of canon; men despised him, crowds feared his mouth.
units.literal: Restless conduct and fawning words, giving full play to his treachery; he rarely knew righteousness, heedless of canonical text; men despised his heart, the crowd feared his mouth.

units.zh: 出州入省，歷忝清資，而長惡不悛，曾無忌諱，毀譽由己，憎惡任情。
units.en: Out to provinces, in the Secretariat on pure posts, he long did evil unrepentant; praise and blame were his, hatred his whim.
units.literal: Going out to provinces, entering the Secretariat, he repeatedly held pure posts, yet long did evil without repentance, never restrained; praise and blame were his own, hatred and favor at his whim.

units.zh: 比因安平王事，遂肆其褊心，因公報隙，與郎中畢義雲遞相糾舉。
units.en: Recently over the Prince of Anping he gave play to narrow heart, repaying grudges through office, mutually impeaching with Bi Yiyun.
units.literal: Recently because of the Prince of Anping Wang matter he then gave full play to his narrow heart, using public business to repay a grudge, mutually impeaching with bureau gentleman Bi Yiyun.

units.zh: 又左外兵郎中魏叔道牒云：『局內降人左澤等為京畿送省，令取保放出。』
units.en: Also Wei Shudao of Left Outer Army Bureau wrote: 'Surrendered men Zuo Ze were sent to the capital with orders to release on guaranty.'
units.literal: Also Left Outer Army Bureau gentleman Wei Shudao's document said: 'Within the bureau surrendered men Zuo Ze and others were sent to the capital by the capital region with orders to release on guaranty.'

units.zh: 大將軍在省日，判『聽』。
units.en: When the great general was in the province he judged 'allow.'
units.literal: When the great general was in the province he judged 'hear and allow.'

units.zh: 遊道發怒曰：『往日官府何物官府，將此為例！』
units.en: Youdao raged: 'What sort of office was that, to take as precedent!'
units.literal: Youdao grew angry and said: 'In past days what sort of office was that office, that you take this as precedent!'

units.zh: 又云：『乘前旨格，成何物旨格！』
units.en: Also: 'Riding a former edict—what edict is that!'
units.literal: Also he said: 'Riding on a former edict pattern—what sort of edict pattern is that!'

units.zh: 依事請問，遊道並皆承引。
units.en: Questioned on the matter, Youdao acknowledged all.
units.literal: Asked according to the matter, Youdao acknowledged all.

units.zh: 案律：『對捍詔使，無人臣之禮，大不敬者死。』
units.en: By code: 'Resisting an edict-bearing envoy without minister's rites—death for great irreverence.'
units.literal: According to the code: 'Resisting and defying an edict-bearing envoy—without a minister's rites, great irreverence is death.'

units.zh: 對捍使者尚得死坐，況遊道吐不臣之言，犯慢上之罪，口稱夷、齊，心懷盜跖，欺公賣法，受納苞苴，產隨官厚，財與位積，雖贓汚未露，而姦詐如是。
units.en: Resisting an envoy earns death; how much more unministered words, slighting superiors, mouth naming Yi and Qi while heart harbors robbers, deceiving the public, taking bribes—wealth piled with rank though bribery was not yet exposed.
units.literal: Resisting an envoy still earns death; how much more Youdao's unministered words, the crime of slighting superiors, mouth naming Yi and Qi while heart harboring robbers, deceiving the public and selling the law, receiving wrapped bribes—property following office thick, wealth with rank piled; though bribery was not yet exposed, treachery was such.

units.zh: 舉此一隅，餘詐可驗。
units.en: This one corner proves the rest.
units.literal: Citing this one corner, the rest of the fraud can be verified.

units.zh: 今依禮據律處遊道死罪。」
units.en: Now by ritual and law we place Youdao in the death crime."
units.literal: Now according to ritual and law we place Youdao in the death crime."

units.zh: 是時朝士皆分為遊道不濟。
units.en: Court gentlemen took sides, thinking Youdao would fail.
units.literal: At the time court gentlemen all took sides, thinking Youdao would not succeed.

units.zh: 而文襄聞其與隆之相抗之言，謂楊遵彥曰：「此真是鯁直大剛惡人。」
units.en: Gao Cheng, hearing his clash with Longzhi, told Yang Zunyan: "This is truly a straight, hard, evil man."
units.literal: Yet Gao Cheng, hearing his words contending with Longzhi, told Yang Zunyan: "This is truly a straight, great, hard evil man."

units.zh: 遵彥曰：「譬之畜狗，本取其吠，今以數吠殺之，恐將來無復吠狗。」
units.en: Zunyan said: "Like a dog kept for barking—kill it for barking too much and later none will bark."
units.literal: Zunyan said: "It is like keeping a dog—you take it for its barking; now if you kill it for barking too much, I fear later there will be no dog to bark."

units.zh: 詔付廷尉，遊道坐除名。
units.en: An edict sent him to the Court of Justice; Youdao was removed from office.
units.literal: An edict sent him to the Court of Justice; Youdao was sentenced to removal from name.

units.zh: 文襄使元景康謂曰：「卿早逐我向幷州，不爾，他經略殺卿。」
units.en: Gao Cheng sent Yuan Jingkang: "Follow me early to Bing—or others in strategy will kill you."
units.literal: Gao Cheng sent Yuan Jingkang to tell him: "You early follow me to Bing province, or else others in strategy will kill you."

units.zh: 遊道從至晉陽，以為大行臺吏部，又以為太原公開府諮議。
units.en: Youdao followed to Jinyang as Traveling Court personnel director and advisory staff of the Taiyuan Duke's office.
units.literal: Youdao followed to Jinyang and was made Traveling Court personnel director; also made advisory staff of Taiyuan Duke's opening office.

units.zh: 及平陽公為中尉，遊道以諮議領書侍御史。
units.en: When the Prince of Pingyang was commandant, Youdao as advisory staff held writing attendant censor.
units.literal: When Prince of Pingyang was commandant, Youdao as advisory staff held the writing attendant censor post.

units.zh: 尋以本官兼司徒左長史。
units.en: Soon he concurrently held Secretariat Left chief administrator.
units.literal: Soon with his original post he concurrently held Secretariat Left chief administrator.

units.zh: 及文襄疑黃門郎溫子昇知元瑾之謀，繫之獄而餓之，食敝襦而死。
units.en: When Gao Cheng suspected Wen Zisheng of Yuan Jin's plot, he bound and starved him—he ate his ragged coat and died.
units.literal: When Gao Cheng suspected Yellow Gate gentleman Wen Zisheng of knowing Yuan Jin's plot, he bound him in prison and starved him—he ate his ragged coat and died.

units.zh: 棄屍路隅，遊道收而葬之。
units.en: The corpse was cast by the road; Youdao collected and buried it.
units.literal: The corpse was cast by the roadside; Youdao collected and buried it.

units.zh: 文襄謂曰：「吾近書與京師諸貴，論及朝士，卿僻於朋黨，將為一病。
units.en: Gao Cheng said: "I wrote the capital nobles on court gentlemen—you lean to factions; that is one sickness.
units.literal: Gao Cheng said: "I recently wrote to the nobles of the capital discussing court gentlemen—you are partial to factions; that will be one sickness.

units.zh: 今卿真是重舊節義人，此情不可奪。
units.en: Now you truly weigh old ties and righteousness; that cannot be taken.
units.literal: Now you are truly a man who weighs old ties and righteousness; that feeling cannot be taken away.

units.zh: 子昇吾本不殺之，卿葬之何所憚。
units.en: I would not have killed Zisheng—what fear in burying him?
units.literal: I originally would not kill Zisheng—what do you fear in burying him?

units.zh: 天下人代卿怖者，是不知吾心也。」
units.en: Those who would replace you in fear do not know my heart."
units.literal: Those in the world who would replace you in fear do not know my heart."

units.zh: 尋除御史中尉。
units.en: Soon he was made censor-in-chief.
units.literal: Soon he was made censor-in-chief.

units.zh: 東萊王道習參御史選，限外投狀，道習與遊道有舊，使令史受之。
units.en: Prince of Donglai Dao Xi joined censor selection and submitted beyond the limit; old friends with Youdao, he had the clerk receive it.
units.literal: Prince of Donglai Dao Xi joined censor selection; beyond the limit he submitted a petition; Dao Xi was old friends with Youdao and had the clerk receive it.

units.zh: 文襄怒，杖遊道而判之曰：「遊道稟性遒悍，是非肆口，吹毛洗垢，瘡疵人物。
units.en: Gao Cheng flogged Youdao and judged: "Youdao is fierce; right and wrong pour from his mouth; he blows hairs to find dirt and scars men.
units.literal: Gao Cheng was angry, flogged Youdao and judged: "Youdao's nature is fierce and tough; right and wrong pour from his mouth; he blows hairs to wash away dirt and scars men's persons.

units.zh: 往與郎中蘭景雲忿競，列事十條。
units.en: Formerly he quarreled with Lan Jingyun, listing ten items.
units.literal: Formerly he quarreled with bureau gentleman Lan Jingyun, listing ten items.

units.zh: 及加推窮，便是虛妄。
units.en: Pushed and examined, they were false.
units.literal: When pushed and examined, they were empty and false.

units.zh: 方共道習淩侮朝典，法官而犯，特是難原，宜付省科。」
units.en: Now with Dao Xi he insults court canon—a judge who violates it is hard to forgive; hand to the province."
units.literal: Now together with Dao Xi he insults and violates the court canon—a judge who violates it is especially hard to forgive; he should be handed to the province for punishment."

units.zh: 遊道被禁，獄吏欲為脫枷，遊道不肯曰：「此令命所著，不可輒脫。」
units.en: Imprisoned, clerks wished to remove his cangue; Youdao refused: "Orders are written here—it cannot be removed."
units.literal: Youdao was imprisoned; prison clerks wished to remove his cangue; Youdao would not: "This is where orders are written—it cannot be lightly removed."

units.zh: 文襄聞而免之。
units.en: Gao Cheng heard and pardoned him.
units.literal: Gao Cheng heard and pardoned him.

units.zh: 遊道抗志不改。
units.en: Youdao's upright will did not change.
units.literal: Youdao's upright will did not change.

units.zh: 天保元年，以遊道兼太府卿，乃於少府覆檢主司盜截，得鉅萬計。
units.en: In Tianbao's first year Youdao was made concurrent Grand Steward of the Palace; re-examining the chief office at the Lesser Treasury for theft, he uncovered a sum in the tens of thousands.
units.literal: In the first year of Tianbao, Youdao was made concurrent Grand Steward of the Palace; he then at the Lesser Treasury re-examined the chief office theft and interception and obtained a huge sum.

units.zh: 奸吏返誣奏之，下獄。
units.en: Corrupt clerks turned on him with false accusations; he was thrown into prison.
units.literal: Corrupt clerks in turn slandered and memorialized against him; he was cast into prison.

units.zh: 尋得出，不歸家，徑之府理事。
units.en: He was soon released, did not go home, and went straight to his office to work.
units.literal: Soon he was released, did not return home, and went straight to the office to handle affairs.

units.zh: 卒，遺令薄葬，不立碑表，不求贈諡。
units.en: When he died he ordered a plain burial—no stele, no marker, no posthumous title sought.
units.literal: At death he left instructions for a simple burial, no stele or tablet, and no request for a posthumous title.

units.zh: 贈瓜州刺史。
units.en: He was posthumously made Governor of Guazhou.
units.literal: Posthumously made Governor of Guazhou.

units.zh: 武平中以子士素久典機密，重贈儀同三司，諡曰貞惠。
units.en: In the Wuping era, because his son Shisu had long handled state secrets, he was again posthumously made Pillar of State with the posthumous name Upright and Gracious.
units.literal: In Wuping, because his son Shisu had long held confidential duties, he was again posthumously made Pillar of State, posthumous name Zhenhui.

units.zh: 遊道剛直，疾惡如讐，見人犯罪，皆欲致之極法。
units.en: Youdao was rigidly upright and hated wrongdoing like an enemy; whenever he saw a crime he wanted the harshest penalty applied.
units.literal: Youdao was upright and rigid, hating evil as though it were a foe; seeing anyone commit a crime, he wished to bring them to the utmost penalty.

units.zh: 彈糾見事，又好察陰私。
units.en: He impeached whatever came before him and loved to probe private conduct as well.
units.literal: He impeached matters before his eyes and also loved to probe private affairs.

units.zh: 問獄察情，捶撻嚴酷。
units.en: In interrogation he read circumstances through beatings that were savage and cruel.
units.literal: In questioning prisoners and examining circumstances, beating and flogging were severe and cruel.

units.zh: 兗州刺史李子貞在州貪暴，遊道案之。
units.en: Li Zizhen, inspector of Yanzhou, was greedy and brutal in his province; Youdao took up the case.
units.literal: Yanzhou Inspector Li Zizhen was greedy and violent in the province; Youdao investigated him.

units.zh: 文襄以貞預建義勳，意將含忍。
units.en: Gao Cheng meant to show forbearance because Zizhen had helped in the founding struggle.
units.literal: Gao Cheng, because Zizhen had shared in the merit of founding the righteous cause, intended to be forbearing.

units.zh: 遊道疑陳元康為其內助，密啟云：「子貞、元康交遊，恐其別有請囑。」
units.en: Youdao suspected Chen Yuankang was backing him from within and secretly wrote, "Zizhen and Yuankang are close; I fear there are other private arrangements."
units.literal: Youdao suspected Chen Yuankang was his inside helper and secretly reported: "Zizhen and Yuankang associate; I fear they have other private requests."

units.zh: 文襄怒，於尚書都堂集百僚，撲殺子貞。
units.en: Gao Cheng flew into a rage, assembled the hundred officials in the main hall of the Masters of Writing, and beat Zizhen to death on the spot.
units.literal: Gao Cheng in anger, at the Masters of Writing main hall assembled the hundred officials and beat Zizhen to death.

units.zh: 又兗州人為遊道生立祠堂，像題曰「忠清君」。
units.en: Men of Yanzhou also built him a living shrine, with an image inscribed "Lord Loyal and Pure."
units.literal: Moreover, men of Yanzhou while he still lived built a shrine to Youdao, with his image inscribed "Lord Loyal and Pure."

units.zh: 遊道別劾吉寧等五人同死，有欣悅色。
units.en: Youdao separately impeached Ji Ning and four others for the same death sentence, his face bright with satisfaction.
units.literal: Youdao separately impeached Ji Ning and four others to die together, with a look of pleasure.

units.zh: 朝士甚鄙之。
units.en: Court gentlemen despised him for it.
units.literal: Court gentlemen greatly despised him for it.

units.zh: 然重交遊，存然諾之分。
units.en: Yet he prized friendship and kept his pledged word.
units.literal: Yet he valued friendship and kept the bond of pledged word.

units.zh: 歷官嚴整，而時大納賄，分及親故之艱匱者，其男女孤弱為嫁娶之，臨喪必哀，躬親襄事。
units.en: In office he was stern and exacting, yet he also took heavy bribes and shared them with kin and friends in need; he arranged marriages for orphaned men and women, and at every funeral he mourned deeply and handled the rites himself.
units.literal: Through his offices he was stern and orderly, yet at times took large bribes and distributed them to kin and friends in hardship and want; for orphaned men and women he arranged marriages, and at funerals he was always mournful and personally assisted in the rites.

units.zh: 為司州綱紀與牧昌樂、西河二王乖忤，及二王薨，每事經恤之，與頓丘李獎一面，便定死交。
units.en: As Si Province regulator he fell out with the Changlean and Xihe princes; when both died he still looked after their affairs. With Li Jiang of Dunqiu he met once and swore friendship unto death.
units.literal: As Si Province regulator he clashed with the princes governing Changlean and Xihe; when the two princes died, he showed care in every matter concerning them. With Dunqiu Li Jiang, after one meeting they swore death friendship.

units.zh: 獎曰：「我年位已高。
units.en: Jiang said, "My years and rank are already high.
units.literal: Jiang said: "My years and rank are already high.

units.zh: 會用弟為佐史，令弟北面於我足矣。」
units.en: When the time comes I will use my younger brother as aide; let him face north to me and that will do."
units.literal: When the time comes I will employ my younger brother as aide; having him face north toward me is enough."

units.zh: 遊道曰：「不能。」
units.en: Youdao said, "I cannot."
units.literal: Youdao said: "I cannot."

units.zh: 旣而獎為河南尹，辟遊道為中正，使者相屬，以衣帢待之，握手歡謔。
units.en: Soon Jiang became Intendant of Henan and appointed Youdao impartial judge; envoys came one after another, and he received him informally, clasping hands in easy jest.
units.literal: Before long Jiang became Intendant of Henan and summoned Youdao as impartial judge; messengers came in succession, and he received him with headcloth, hand in hand in merry banter.

units.zh: 元顥入洛，獎受其命，出使徐州，都督元孚與城人趙紹兵殺之。
units.en: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, Jiang accepted his orders and went to Xuzhou on mission; Area Commander Yuan Fu and a townsman named Zhao Shao killed him with troops.
units.literal: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, Jiang accepted his commission and went out as envoy to Xuzhou; Area Commander Yuan Fu with the city man Zhao Shao killed him by force of arms.

units.zh: 遊道為獎訟冤，得雪，又表為請贈，廻己考一泛階以益之。
units.en: Youdao sued to clear Jiang's name and won, then memorialized for posthumous honors, deducting one grade from his own review to add to Jiang's.
units.literal: Youdao pleaded Jiang's grievance and cleared his name, and also memorialized to request posthumous honors, turning back one grade from his own examination to add to Jiang's.

units.zh: 又與劉廞結交，託廞弟粹於徐州殺趙紹。
units.en: He also befriended Liu Yin and had Yin's younger brother Cui kill Zhao Shao at Xuzhou.
units.literal: He also befriended Liu Yin and entrusted Yin's younger brother Cui at Xuzhou to kill Zhao Shao.

units.zh: 後劉廞伏法於洛陽，粹以徐州叛，官軍討平之，梟粹首於鄴市。
units.en: Later Liu Yin was executed at Luoyang; Cui rebelled in Xuzhou, government troops put him down, and his head was displayed in the Ye market.
units.literal: Later Liu Yin was executed by law at Luoyang; Cui rebelled at Xuzhou, government troops suppressed him, and Cui's head was exposed at Ye market.

units.zh: 孫騰使客告市司，得錢五百萬後聽收。
units.en: Sun Teng sent an agent to the market office saying they could collect the head only after five million cash was paid.
units.literal: Sun Teng sent a client to tell the market office that only after five million cash was received would they be allowed to take it down.

units.zh: 遊道時為司州中從事，令家人作劉粹所親，於州陳訴，依律判「許」而奏之。
units.en: Youdao was then Central Army aide in Si Province; he had his household pose as Liu Cui's relatives, sue in the province, obtain a legal ruling of "permitted," and memorialized it.
units.literal: Youdao was then Central Army aide of Si Province; he had his household pose as Liu Cui's kin, filed suit in the province, and by law obtained a ruling of "permitted" and memorialized it.

units.zh: 勑至，市司猶不許。
units.en: When the edict arrived, the market office still refused.
units.literal: When the edict arrived, the market office still would not allow it.

units.zh: 遊道杖司，勒使速付。
units.en: Youdao beat the market staff and forced them to surrender the head immediately.
units.literal: Youdao flogged the office staff and compelled them to hand it over at once.

units.zh: 騰聞大怒。
units.en: Teng was furious when he heard.
units.literal: When Teng heard of it he was greatly enraged.

units.zh: 時李獎二子構、訓居貧，遊道後令其求三富人死事，判免之，凡得錢百五十萬，盡以入構、訓。
units.en: Li Jiang's sons Gou and Xun were then poor; Youdao later had them find three wealthy men facing capital charges, win acquittals, and collect one million five hundred thousand cash, which he gave them in full.
units.literal: At the time Li Jiang's two sons Gou and Xun lived in poverty; Youdao later had them seek three rich men on capital charges, obtain acquittal, and in all got one million five hundred thousand cash, which he gave entirely to Gou and Xun.

units.zh: 其使氣黨俠如此。
units.en: His swaggering, faction-bound chivalry was of this sort.
units.literal: His bravado and chivalric partisanship were like this.

units.zh: 時人語曰：「遊道獼猴面，陸操科斗形，意識不關貌，何謂醜者必無情。」
units.en: A saying of the time ran, "Youdao has a monkey's face and Lu Cao a tadpole's body—mind has nothing to do with looks; why assume the ugly are heartless?"
units.literal: People said at the time: "Youdao has a monkey's face, Lu Cao a tadpole's shape; awareness has nothing to do with looks—why say the ugly must be without feeling?"

units.zh: 構嘗因遊道會客，因戲之曰：「賢從在門外，大好人，宜自迎接。」
units.en: Once, while Gou was at Youdao's gathering of guests, he teased him: "Your excellent cousin is at the gate—a fine fellow; you ought to welcome him yourself."
units.literal: Gou once at Youdao's reception for guests playfully said to him: "Your worthy cousin is outside the gate, a very fine man—you should go welcome him yourself."

units.zh: 為通名稱「族弟遊山。」
units.en: He sent word in under the name "clansman You Shan."
units.literal: He had him announced under the name "clansman cousin You Shan."

units.zh: 遊道出見之，乃獼猴衣帽也。
units.en: Youdao went out to receive him and found monkey cap and clothes.
units.literal: Youdao went out to see him—it was monkey cap and clothes.

units.zh: 將與構絕，構謝之，豁然如舊。
units.en: He was ready to break with Gou, but Gou apologized and they were suddenly close again.
units.literal: He was about to break with Gou, but Gou apologized and they were suddenly as before.

units.zh: 遊道死後，構為定州長史，遊道第三子士孫為墨曹、博陵王管記，與典籖共誣奏構。
units.en: After Youdao's death, Gou became chief clerk of Dingzhou; Youdao's third son Shisun, registrar in the Ink Office and recorder to the Prince of Boling, joined the registry keeper in a false accusation against Gou.
units.literal: After Youdao died, Gou became chief clerk of Dingzhou; Youdao's third son Shisun was Ink Office registrar and recorder for the Prince of Boling, and together with the registry keeper falsely memorialized against Gou.

units.zh: 構於禁所祭遊道而訴焉。
units.en: Imprisoned, Gou sacrificed to Youdao and pleaded to him.
units.literal: Gou in the detention house offered sacrifice to Youdao and appealed to him.

units.zh: 士遜晝臥如夢者，見遊道怒己曰：「我與構恩義，汝豈不知，何共小人謀陷清直之士！」
units.en: Shixun napped by day as if dreaming and saw Youdao rebuke him: "Jiang and I were bound in grace and duty—do you not know it? How dare you join petty men to trap an upright man!"
units.literal: Shixun by day lay asleep as in a dream and saw Youdao angrily addressing him: "Jiang and I had bond of grace and duty—do you not know it? How can you join petty men to plot against an upright man!"

units.zh: 士遜驚跪曰：「不敢，不敢。」
units.en: Shixun knelt in terror and said, "I dare not, I dare not."
units.literal: Shixun in alarm knelt and said: "I dare not, I dare not."

units.zh: 旬日而卒。
units.en: Within ten days he was dead.
units.literal: Within ten days he died.

units.zh: 遊道每戒其子士素、士約、士慎等曰：「吾執法太剛，數遭屯蹇，性自如此，子孫不足以師之。」
units.en: Youdao often warned his sons Shisu, Shiyue, Shishen, and the rest: "I enforced the law too harshly and met setback after setback—that is my nature; my descendants should not take me as their model."
units.literal: Youdao often admonished his sons Shisu, Shiyue, Shishen, and others: "My law enforcement is too rigid; I have repeatedly met setbacks—such is my nature; descendants are not fit to take me as teacher."

units.zh: 諸子奉父言，柔和謙遜。
units.en: His sons obeyed and were gentle and humble.
units.literal: The sons obeyed their father's words and were gentle and modest.

units.zh: 士素沈密少言，有才識。
units.en: Shisu was reserved and sparing of speech, with talent and discernment.
units.literal: Shisu was deep, reticent, and few of words, with talent and judgment.

units.zh: 稍遷中書舍人。
units.en: He rose gradually to Secretariat Attendant.
units.literal: He was gradually promoted to Secretariat Attendant.

units.zh: 趙彥深引入內省，參典機密，歷中書、黃門侍郎，遷儀同三司、散騎常侍，常領黃門侍郎。
units.en: Zhao Yanshen brought him into the inner secretariat for confidential work; he served as secretariat and yellow gate attendant, then was promoted to Pillar of State and scattered-cavalry regular attendant, usually heading the yellow gate attendant office.
units.literal: Zhao Yanshen brought him into the inner secretariat to share confidential duties; he passed through Secretariat and Yellow Gate Attendant posts, was promoted to Pillar of State and Scattered Cavalry Regular Attendant, and regularly headed the Yellow Gate Attendant office.

units.zh: 自處機要近二十年，周慎溫恭，甚為彥深所重。
units.en: For nearly twenty years he stood at the heart of power, careful, warm, and respectful, and Yanshen held him in high regard.
units.literal: He held himself at the nerve center of power for nearly twenty years, circumspect, warm, and respectful, and was greatly valued by Yanshen.

units.zh: 初，祖珽知朝政，出彥深為刺史。
units.en: At first Zu Ting ran the government and sent Yanshen out as provincial inspector.
units.literal: At first Zu Ting controlled court affairs and sent Yanshen out as inspector.

units.zh: 珽奏以士素為東郡守，中書侍郎李德林白珽留之，由是還除黃門侍郎，共參機密。
units.en: Ting memorialized to make Shisu administrator of Dong commandery; secretariat attendant Li Delin urged Ting to keep him, so he was recalled and made yellow gate attendant, again in confidential work.
units.literal: Ting memorialized to make Shisu Administrator of Dong commandery; Secretariat Attendant Li Delin told Ting to keep him, and thereby he was returned and made Yellow Gate Attendant, again sharing confidential duties.

units.zh: 士約亦為善士，官尚書左丞。
units.en: Shiyue was also a good man and served as left vice director of the masters of writing.
units.literal: Shiyue was also a good man, office Master of Writing Left Vice Director.

units.zh: 盧斐，字子章，范陽涿人也。
units.en: Lu Fei, courtesy name Zizhang, came from Zhuo in Fanyang.
units.literal: Lu Fei, styled Zizhang, was a man of Zhuo in Fanyang.

units.zh: 父同，魏殿中尚書。
units.en: His father Tong had been palace attendant master of writing under the Wei.
units.literal: His father Tong was Wei Palace Attendant Master of Writing.

units.zh: 斐性殘忍，以強斷知名。
units.en: Fei was cruel by nature and famed for harsh, decisive rulings.
units.literal: Fei's nature was cruel; he was known for forceful judgment.

units.zh: 世宗引為相府刑獄參軍。
units.en: Gao Cheng brought him in as legal-prison aide in the chancellor's office.
units.literal: Gao Cheng summoned him as legal-prison aide in the chancellor's office.

units.zh: 謂之云：「狂簡，斐然成章，非佳名字也。」
units.en: He told him, "'Reckless and terse, yet splendor to completion'—not a flattering name."
units.literal: He said to him: "Reckless and terse, yet splendor to completion—not a fine name."

units.zh: 天保中，稍遷尚書左丞，別典京畿詔獄，酷濫非人情所為。
units.en: In the Tianbao era he rose to left vice director of the masters of writing and separately ran capital-region imperial prison cases with cruelty beyond ordinary humanity.
units.literal: In Tianbao he was gradually promoted to Master of Writing Left Vice Director, separately in charge of metropolitan-area imperial prison cases, cruel and excessive beyond what human feeling allows.

units.zh: 無問事之大小，拷掠過度，於大棒車輻下死者非一。
units.en: Regardless of the crime's scale, torture went too far; not a few died under the great rod or the chariot wheel.
units.literal: Without regard to whether the matter was great or small, torture exceeded bounds; under the great rod and chariot wheel hub those who died were not one.

units.zh: 或嚴冬至寒，置囚於冰雪之上；
units.en: Sometimes in bitter midwinter he set prisoners on ice and snow;
units.literal: Sometimes in severe winter's cold he placed prisoners on ice and snow;

units.zh: 或盛夏酷熱，暴之日下。
units.en: sometimes in blazing midsummer he left them in the open sun.
units.literal: sometimes in midsummer's fierce heat he exposed them under the sun.

units.zh: 枉陷人致死者，前後百數。
units.en: Those he framed to death numbered in the hundreds.
units.literal: Those wrongly framed and driven to death numbered in the hundreds before and after.

units.zh: 又伺察官人罪失，動卽奏聞，朝士見之，莫不重跡屏氣，皆目之為盧校事。
units.en: He also spied on officials' faults and reported every move; court gentlemen shortened their steps and held their breath at the sight of him, and all called him Investigator Lu.
units.literal: He also watched officials' faults and at every move memorialized the throne; when court gentlemen saw him, none did not walk with shortened steps and held breath—all called him Investigator Lu.

units.zh: 斐後以謗史，與李庶俱病鞭死獄中。
units.en: Fei later slandered the history; he and Li Shu both died in prison of flogging wounds.
units.literal: Fei later for slandering the history, together with Li Shu, died of flogging-wounds in prison.

units.zh: 畢義雲，小字陀兒。
units.en: Bi Yiyun's childhood name was Tuo'er.
units.literal: Bi Yiyun, childhood name Tuo'er.

units.zh: 少粗俠，家在兗州北境，常劫掠行旅，州里患之。
units.en: Young, he was rough and swaggering; his family lived on Yanzhou's northern frontier and often robbed travelers, to the province's grief.
units.literal: In youth he was rough and chivalric; his family was on Yanzhou's northern border and often robbed travelers—the province and district suffered from him.

units.zh: 晚方折節從官。
units.en: Only late in life did he reform and take office.
units.literal: Only late did he restrain himself and enter office.

units.zh: 累遷尚書都官郎中。
units.en: He rose to director of the bureau of punishments in the masters of writing.
units.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Masters of Writing Director of the Bureau of Punishments.

units.zh: 性嚴酷，事多幹了。
units.en: He was severe and cruel, but in business he was sharp and effective.
units.literal: His nature was severe and cruel, and in affairs he was largely capable and effective.

units.zh: 齊文襄作相，以為稱職，令普勾偽官，專以車輻考掠，所獲甚多。
units.en: When Gao Cheng was chancellor he judged him capable and ordered a sweep for false officials, relying chiefly on chariot-wheel torture; the haul was enormous.
units.literal: When Gao Cheng was chancellor he found him fit for duty and ordered a universal investigation of false officials, using exclusively chariot-wheel torture; what was obtained was very great.

units.zh: 然大起怨謗。
units.en: Yet resentment and outcry rose everywhere.
units.literal: Yet resentment and slander rose greatly.

units.zh: 曾為司州吏所訟，云其有所減截，幷改換文書。
units.en: A Si Province clerk once sued him, claiming he had skimmed funds and falsified documents.
units.literal: He was once sued by a Si Province clerk who said he had skimmed funds and altered documents together.

units.zh: 文襄以其推偽，衆人怨望，並無所問，乃拘吏數人而斬之。
units.en: Gao Cheng, since Yiyun was exposing false officials and the crowd was bitter, ignored the charge and instead detained several clerks and beheaded them.
units.literal: Gao Cheng, because he was pressing false officials and the crowd was resentful, questioned nothing of it; instead he detained several clerks and beheaded them.

units.zh: 因此銳情訊鞠，威名日盛。
units.en: After that his zeal for interrogation sharpened and his fearsome name spread.
units.literal: From this his zeal for interrogation sharpened and his dread name grew daily.

units.zh: 文宣受禪，除治書侍御史，彈射不避勳親。
units.en: When Gao Yang took the throne he was made attending censor for drafting and in impeachment spared no meritorious kin.
units.literal: When Gao Yang received the abdication he was made Attending Censor for Drafting; in impeachment he did not avoid meritorious kin.

units.zh: 累遷御史中丞，繩劾更切。
units.en: He rose to censor-in-chief, and his restraints and impeachments grew still harsher.
units.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Censor-in-Chief; restraints and impeachment grew still sharper.

units.zh: 然豪橫不平，頻被怨訟。
units.en: Yet he was domineering and unjust and was sued again and again out of spite.
units.literal: Yet he was overbearing and unfair and was repeatedly sued in resentment.

units.zh: 前為汲郡太守翟嵩啟列：「義雲從父兄僧明負官債，先任京畿長吏，不受其屬，立限切征，由此挾嫌，數遣御史過郡訪察，欲相推繩。
units.en: Earlier, as administrator of Ji commandery, Zhai Song had memorialized: "Yiyun's cousin Sengming owed official debt; when Sengming was metropolitan chief clerk he refused Yiyun's men and set harsh collection deadlines; nursing a grudge, Yiyun kept sending censors through the commandery to investigate and impeach him.
units.literal: Formerly as Administrator of Ji Commandery, Zhai Song memorialized listing: "Yi Yun's paternal cousin Sengming owed official debt; having first served as metropolitan-area chief clerk, he did not accept Yi Yun's subordinates and set strict deadlines for collection; thereby nursing a grudge, he repeatedly sent censors through the commandery to investigate, wishing to impeach each other.

units.zh: 又坐私藏工匠，家有十餘機織錦，並造金銀器物。」
units.en: He was also charged with hiding artisans privately—more than ten brocade looms at home and gold and silver work besides."
units.literal: He was also charged with privately hoarding artisans; his household had more than ten looms weaving brocade, and moreover made gold and silver vessels."

units.zh: 乃被禁止。
units.en: He was then placed under detention.
units.literal: He was then detained.

units.zh: 尋見釋，以為司徒左長史。
units.en: He was soon released and made Left Chief Clerk to the Minister of Education.
units.literal: Soon he was released and made Left Chief Clerk of the Ministry of Works.

units.zh: 尚書左丞司馬子瑞奏彈義雲，稱：「天保元年四月，竇氏皇姨祖載日，內外百官赴第吊省，義雲唯遣御史投名，身遂不赴。
units.en: Left vice director Sima Zirui impeached Yiyun, writing: "In the fourth month of Tianbao year one, on the burial day of Empress Dowager Dou's imperial aunt, officials inside and out went to mourn; Yiyun only sent a censor to register his name and did not attend.
units.literal: Master of Writing Left Vice Director Sima Zirui memorialized to impeach Yi Yun, stating: "In the fourth month of the first year of Tianbao, on the day of the Empress Dowager Dou's imperial aunt's burial, inner and outer officials of every rank went to her residence to mourn; Yi Yun only sent a censor to submit his name and himself did not go.

units.zh: 又義雲啟云：『喪婦孤貧，後娶李世安女為妻。
units.en: Yiyun had also reported, 'My wife died and I am poor and alone; I later took Li Shi'an's daughter in marriage.
units.literal: Moreover Yi Yun reported: 'My wife died and I am poor and alone; I later took Li Shi'an's daughter as wife.

units.zh: 世安身雖父服未終，其女為祖已就平吉，特乞暗迎，不敢備禮。』
units.en: Though Shi'an is still in mourning for his father, his daughter had already passed the grandfather's peaceful day; I beg a secret welcome and dare not hold full ceremony.'
units.literal: Though Shi'an's person is still within mourning for his father, his daughter for her grandfather had already passed the peaceful day; I specially beg a secret welcome and dare not prepare full rites.'

units.zh: 及義雲成婚之夕，衆儲備設，克日拜閤，鳴騶清路，盛列羽儀，兼差臺吏二十人，責其鮮服侍從車後。
units.en: Yet on his wedding night the stores were piled high; on the appointed day he bowed at the gate, runners cleared the road, feathered guards paraded in splendor, and twenty bureau clerks were sent to demand fresh dress and follow his carriage.
units.literal: Yet on the night Yi Yun's marriage was completed, the crowd was fully stored and set out; on the fixed day he bowed at the gate, outriders cleared the road, feathered insignia were arrayed in splendor, and moreover twenty bureau clerks were dispatched to demand fresh clothes and attend behind his carriage.

units.zh: 直是茍求成婚，誣罔干上。
units.en: It was plainly a shameless rush to marry and a lie pressed on his superiors.
units.literal: It was plainly a shameless demand for marriage and deception importuning superiors.

units.zh: 義雲資產宅宇足稱豪至，忽道孤貧，亦為矯詐。
units.en: Yiyun's property and house were lavish enough to count as grand; to call himself poor and alone was fraud as well.
units.literal: Yi Yun's assets and dwellings were enough to be called grand and extreme; suddenly to speak of poverty and solitude was also pretense and fraud.

units.zh: 法官如此，直繩焉寄？
units.en: If judges behave thus, where is upright law to be found?
units.literal: When judges are like this, where can upright rule be entrusted?

units.zh: 又駕幸晉陽，都坐判：『拜起居表，四品以下五品已上令預前一日赴南都署表，三品以上臨日署訖。』
units.en: When the emperor went to Jinyang, the chief seat ruled: 'For the bowing-salutation memorial, officials from fourth rank down through fifth rank and up must sign at the southern capital office the day before; third rank and above sign on the day itself.'
units.literal: Moreover when the emperor visited Jinyang, the chief seat ruled: 'For bowing the salutation memorial, those of fifth rank and above from fourth rank down are to go the day before to the southern capital office to sign the memorial; those of third rank and above sign it on the day itself.'

units.zh: 義雲乃乖例，署表之日，索表就家先署，臨日遂稱私忌不來。」
units.en: Yiyun broke precedent: on signing day he had the memorial brought home and signed first, then on the day itself pleaded private taboo and stayed away."
units.literal: Yi Yun then violated precedent; on the day of signing the memorial he demanded the memorial and signed it first at home, and on the day itself then claimed private taboo and did not come."

units.zh: 於是詔付廷尉科罪，尋勑免推。
units.en: An edict sent him to the Court of Judicature; soon another order halted the case.
units.literal: Thereupon an edict handed him to the Court of Judicature for sentencing; soon an order excused further prosecution.

units.zh: 子瑞又奏彈義雲事十餘條，多煩碎，罪止罰金，不至除免。
units.en: Zirui impeached him again on more than ten petty counts; punishment stopped at a fine and did not cost him his post.
units.literal: Zirui again memorialized to impeach Yi Yun on more than ten matters, mostly trivial; the crime stopped at a fine and did not reach removal.

units.zh: 子瑞從兄消難為北豫州刺史，義雲遣御史張子階詣州采風聞，先禁其典籖家客等。
units.en: Zirui's cousin Xiaonan was inspector of North Yuzhou; Yiyun sent censor Zhang Zijie to gather rumors and first detained his registry keeper, household agents, and the like.
units.literal: Zirui's cousin Xiaonan was Inspector of North Yuzhou; Yi Yun sent Censor Zhang Zijie to the province to gather hearsay and first detained his registry keeper, household clients, and the like.

units.zh: 消難危懼，遂叛入周。
units.en: Terrified, Xiaonan rebelled and fled to Zhou.
units.literal: Xiaonan in peril and fear then rebelled and entered Zhou.

units.zh: 時論歸罪義雲，云其規報子瑞，事亦上聞。
units.en: Public opinion blamed Yiyun for scheming revenge on Zirui, and word reached the throne.
units.literal: Opinion of the time laid blame on Yi Yun, saying he had plotted retaliation against Zirui; the matter also reached the throne.

units.zh: 爾前讌嘗，義雲常預，從此後集見稍疏，聲望大損。
units.en: Before this he had always been at court feasts; afterward he was seen less often and his standing collapsed.
units.literal: Before this at banquets and feasts Yi Yun was always present; from this time onward his appearances at gatherings grew somewhat sparse and his reputation greatly fell.

units.zh: 乾明初，子瑞遷御史中丞。
units.en: Early in Qianming, Zirui became censor-in-chief.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qianming, Zirui was transferred to Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 鄭子默正被任用，義雲之姑卽子默祖母，遂除度支尚書，攝左丞。
units.en: Zheng Zimo was then in favor; Yiyun's aunt was Zimo's grandmother, so he was made minister of revenue and acting left vice director.
units.literal: Zheng Zimo was then in active use; Yi Yun's paternal aunt was Zimo's grandmother, and he was therefore made Minister of Revenue and acting Left Vice Director.

units.zh: 子默誅後，左丞便解。
units.en: After Zimo was killed, he gave up the acting left vice director post at once.
units.literal: After Zimo was executed, the left vice director post was at once relinquished.

units.zh: 孝昭赴晉陽，高元海留鄴，義雲深相依附。
units.en: When Gao Yan went to Jinyang and Gao Yuanhai stayed at Ye, Yiyun attached himself to Yuanhai with deep reliance.
units.literal: When Gao Yan went to Jinyang, Gao Yuanhai remained at Ye; Yi Yun clung to him in deep dependence.

units.zh: 知其信向釋氏，常隨之聽講，為此款密，無所不至。
units.en: Knowing Yuanhai was devoted to the Buddhist teaching, Yiyun often followed him to lectures; for that warm friendship he spared no effort.
units.literal: Knowing that he was devoted to the Buddhist teaching, [Yiyun] often followed him to hear lectures; for this intimate friendship he went to every length.

units.zh: 及孝昭大漸，顧命武成。
units.en: When Emperor Xiaozhao grew critically ill, he entrusted the succession to Gao Zhan.
units.literal: When Xiaozhao grew critically ill, he entrusted the succession to Gao Zhan.

units.zh: 高歸彥至都，武成猶致疑惑。
units.en: When Gao Guiyan reached the capital, Gao Zhan still harbored doubts about him.
units.literal: When Gao Guiyan reached the capital, Gao Zhan still harbored doubts about him.

units.zh: 元海遣犢車迎義雲入北宮參審，遂與元海等勸進，仍從幸晉陽，參預時政。
units.en: Yuanhai sent an ox cart to bring Yiyun into the Northern Palace for the deliberations; he then joined Yuanhai and the others in urging Gao Zhan to the throne, followed the court to Jinyang, and took part in affairs of state.
units.literal: Yuanhai sent an ox cart to bring Yiyun into the Northern Palace to take part in the deliberations; he then joined Yuanhai and the others in urging [Gao Zhan] to take the throne, followed the imperial progress to Jinyang, and joined in the government of the time.

units.zh: 尋除兗州刺史，給後部鼓吹，卽本州也，軒昂自得，意望銓衡之舉。
units.en: Soon he was made governor of Yan Province and given rear-guard musicians—it was his native province. He carried himself with lofty pride, his hopes set on a capital post in the personnel offices.
units.literal: Soon he was appointed Governor of Yan Province, given rear-guard musicians—it was his home province; he bore himself loftily and at ease, his ambition fixed on an appointment through the evaluation and selection offices.

units.zh: 見諸人自陳，逆許引接。
units.en: When petitioners came before him, he would assent against expectation and draw them in.
units.literal: When he saw people presenting themselves, he would contrary to expectation assent and draw them in.

units.zh: 又言離別暫時，非久在州。
units.en: He also said his absence was only temporary and he would not long stay in the province.
units.literal: He also said his leave was only temporary and he would not long remain in the province.

units.zh: 先有鐃吹，至於案部行遊，遂兩部並用。
units.en: He already had nao-and-blowing musicians; when he toured his jurisdiction, both bands went out together.
units.literal: He already had nao-and-blowing musicians; when it came to touring his jurisdiction, both ensembles were used together.

units.zh: 猶作書與元海，論敘時事。
units.en: He still wrote Yuanhai a letter discussing affairs of the day.
units.literal: He still wrote a letter to Yuanhai discussing affairs of the time.

units.zh: 元海入內，不覺遺落，給事中李孝貞得而奏之，為此元海漸疏，孝貞因是兼中書舍人。
units.en: Yuanhai entered the palace and dropped it without noticing; palace attendant Li Xiaozhen found it and memorialized it. Yuanhai grew gradually estranged, and Xiaozhen was made concurrent secretariat drafting officer.
units.literal: When Yuanhai entered the palace he inadvertently dropped it; Palace Attendant Li Xiaozhen found it and memorialized it—on this account Yuanhai grew gradually estranged, and Xiaozhen was made concurrent Secretariat Drafting Officer.

units.zh: 又高歸彥起逆，義雲在州私集人馬，並聚甲仗，將以自防，實無他意。
units.en: When Gao Guiyan rose in rebellion, Yiyun in his province privately gathered men and horses and stockpiled arms and armor for self-defense—he truly had no other design.
units.literal: Moreover, when Gao Guiyan rose in rebellion, Yiyun in his province privately gathered men and horses and also stockpiled arms and armor, intending them for his own defense—he truly had no other intent.

units.zh: 為人所啟，及歸彥被擒，又列其朋黨專擅，為此追還。
units.en: Someone reported him; when Guiyan was taken, Yiyun was also named among his partisans who had monopolized power, and for that he was recalled.
units.literal: Someone reported him; when Guiyan was captured, [Yiyun] was also listed among his partisans who monopolized power—for this he was recalled.

units.zh: 武成猶錄其往誠，竟不加罪，除兼七兵尚書。
units.en: Gao Zhan still credited his past loyalty, did not punish him in the end, and appointed him concurrent minister of the seven armies.
units.literal: Gao Zhan still credited his past loyalty, in the end did not punish him, and appointed him concurrent Minister of the Seven Armies.

units.zh: 義雲性豪縱，頗以施惠為心，累世本州刺史，家富於財，士之匱乏者，多有拯濟。
units.en: Yiyun was bold and unrestrained by nature, and took pleasure in doing favors. For generations his family had held the governorship of this province; the house was rich, and many needy scholars he rescued.
units.literal: Yiyun was by nature bold and unrestrained, taking pleasure in showing favor; for generations his family had been governors of this province, his house rich in goods, and many scholars in want he aided and rescued.

units.zh: 及貴，恣情驕侈，營造第宅宏壯，未幾而成。
units.en: Once he rose high, he gave free rein to pride and extravagance and built a mansion so grand it was finished almost at once.
units.literal: Once he grew eminent, he indulged pride and extravagance, building a mansion grand and vast that was finished in no time.

units.zh: 閨門穢雜，聲遍朝野。
units.en: His inner quarters were foul and disorderly; the scandal ran through court and countryside.
units.literal: His inner quarters were foul and disorderly; the scandal ran through court and countryside.

units.zh: 為郎時，與左丞宋遊道因公事忿競，遊道廷辱之云：「《雄狐》之詩，千載為汝。」
units.en: As a gentleman he had quarreled with left vice director Song Youdao over official business; Youdao publicly humiliated him, saying, "The poem 'The Male Fox'—a thousand years it has waited for you."
units.literal: When he was a gentleman, over official business he quarreled with Left Vice Director Song Youdao; Youdao publicly humiliated him, saying: "The poem 'The Male Fox'—for a thousand years it has waited for you."

units.zh: 義雲一無所答。
units.en: Yiyun answered not a word.
units.literal: Yiyun answered not a word.

units.zh: 然酷暴殘忍，非人理所及。
units.en: Yet he was cruel and violent beyond what human reason can compass.
units.literal: Yet he was cruel and violent beyond what human reason can compass.

units.zh: 為家尤甚，子孫仆隸，常瘡痍被體。
units.en: At home it was worst of all—children, grandchildren, and servants were often covered in sores and wounds.
units.literal: At home it was worst of all—children, grandchildren, and servants were often covered in sores and wounds.

units.zh: 有孽子善昭，性至凶頑，與義雲侍婢姦通，搒掠無數，為其著籠頭，系之庭樹，食以芻秣，十餘日乃釋之。
units.en: He had a bastard son, Shanzhao, vicious to the core; he lay with Yiyun's maidservant, and after countless beatings Yiyun put a cangue on him, tied him to a courtyard tree, fed him fodder, and only released him after more than ten days.
units.literal: He had a bastard son, Shanzhao, vicious to the utmost; he fornicated with Yiyun's maidservant, and after countless beatings Yiyun had a cangue put on him, tied him to a tree in the courtyard, fed him fodder, and only released him after more than ten days.

units.zh: 夜中義雲被賊害，卽善昭所佩刀也，遺之於義雲庭中。
units.en: In the night Yiyun was murdered—it was the knife Shanzhao wore; it was left in Yiyun's courtyard.
units.literal: In the night Yiyun was murdered by a thief—it was the knife Shanzhao carried; it was left in Yiyun's courtyard.

units.zh: 善昭聞難奔哭，家人得佩刀，善昭怖，便走出，投平恩墅舍。
units.en: Shanzhao heard of the calamity and ran to weep; when the household found the sword, Shanzhao was terrified and fled at once to the Ping'en villa estate.
units.literal: Shanzhao heard of the calamity and ran to weep; when the household found the worn sword, Shanzhao was frightened and fled at once, taking refuge at the Ping'en villa estate.

units.zh: 旦日，世祖令舍人蘭子暢就宅推之。
units.en: The next day Emperor Xiaozong ordered gentleman-of-the-household Lan Zichang to go to the mansion and investigate.
units.literal: Next day Emperor Xiaozong ordered Gentleman-of-the-Household Lan Zichang to go to the mansion and investigate.

units.zh: 爾前，義雲新納少室范陽盧氏，有色貌。
units.en: Not long before, Yiyun had newly married the Lady Lu of Fanyang from the Shaoshi quarter—she had beauty and charm.
units.literal: Some time before, Yiyun had newly taken in marriage the Lady Lu of Fanyang from the Shaoshi quarter—she had beauty and charm.

units.zh: 子暢疑盧姦人所為，將加拷掠，盧具列善昭云爾，乃收捕繫臨漳獄，將斬之。
units.en: Zichang suspected Lady Lu of adultery and was about to torture her; Lu laid out in full what Shanzhao had done—they seized him, bound him in Linzhang jail, and were about to execute him.
units.literal: Zichang suspected Lady Lu of having done it with an adulterer and was about to put her to torture; Lu set out in full the facts about Shanzhao as told above—they then seized him, imprisoned him in Linzhang jail, and were about to execute him.

units.zh: 邢卲上言，此乃大逆，義雲又是朝貴，不可發。
units.en: Xing Shao submitted a memorial: "This is great treason, and Yiyun was a court noble—the sentence must not be carried out in public."
units.literal: Xing Shao submitted a memorial: "This is great treason; Yiyun was moreover a court noble—the execution must not be carried out in public."

units.zh: 乃斬於獄，棄屍漳水。
units.en: He was beheaded in prison and the corpse cast into the Zhang River.
units.literal: He was beheaded in prison and the corpse cast into the Zhang River.

units.zh: 初，文宣命邢卲制帝名殷，字正道，帝從而尤之曰：「殷家弟及，『正』字一止，吾身後兒不得也。」
units.en: Earlier, Emperor Wenxuan had ordered Xing Shao to devise Yin as the emperor's personal name and Zhengdao as his style. Wenxuan later faulted him for it: "In the house of Yin, brothers succeeded one another, and the character 正 contains a single 'stop.' After I am gone, my son will not have it."
units.literal: Initially, Emperor Wenxuan ordered Xing Shao to devise the emperor's personal name Yin and style Zhengdao; the emperor then faulted him, saying, "In the house of Yin, younger brothers succeeded; the character zheng contains one stop, so after I am gone my son will not get it."

units.zh: 卲懼，請改焉。
units.en: Shao was frightened and asked to change the names.
units.literal: Shao was afraid and asked to change it.

units.zh: 遇李庶，頗以為恥，謂曰：「我此衣服，都是內裁，旣見子將，不能無愧。」
units.en: When he met Li Shu he was ashamed and said, "These clothes were all cut in the inner palace; now that I have seen you, my general, I cannot help feeling shame."
units.literal: Meeting Li Shu, he was quite ashamed and said, "These clothes of mine were all cut within the palace; now that I have seen you, my general, I cannot be without shame."

units.zh: 齊高祖神武皇帝，姓高名歡，字賀六渾，渤海蓚人也。
units.en: Gaozu Emperor Shenwu of Northern Qi bore the surname Gao; his personal name was Huan and his style Heiliuhun. He came from Tiao in Bohai.
units.literal: The Grand Ancestor of Qi, Emperor Shenwu, surname Gao, taboo name Huan, style name Heiliuhun, was a native of Tiao in Bohai.

units.zh: 神武上
units.en: Emperor Shenwu, Part One
units.literal: Emperor Shenwu, Part One

units.zh: 家貧，及聘武明皇后，始有馬，得給鎮為隊主。
units.en: The family was poor, and only after he betrothed Lady Wuming did he acquire a horse and win appointment as squad chief at the garrison.
units.literal: His family was poor; only when he betrothed Empress Wuming did he first have a horse and was able to serve the garrison as squad chief.

units.zh: 神武自隊主轉為函使。
units.en: Gao Huan moved from squad chief to garrison courier.
units.literal: Shenwu advanced from squad chief to courier.

units.zh: 自是乃有澄清天下之志。
units.en: From that day he resolved to set the realm right.
units.literal: From this time he nursed the ambition to cleanse and clarify the realm.

units.zh: 神武旣累世北邊，故習其俗，遂同鮮卑。
units.en: For generations his family had lived on the northern marches, so Gao Huan grew up in frontier ways and lived much like the Xianbei.
units.literal: As for generations his family had been on the northern frontier, Shenwu was accustomed to its customs and came to be as the Xianbei.

units.zh: 六世祖隱，晉玄菟太守。
units.en: In the sixth generation his ancestor Yin had been Administrator of Xuantu under the Jin.
units.literal: His sixth-generation ancestor Yin served as Administrator of Xuantu under Jin.

units.zh: 湖生四子，第三子謐，仕魏，位至侍御史，坐法徙居懷朔鎮。
units.en: Hu had four sons. The third, Mi, served the Wei court and rose to Attending Censor, but after a legal infraction was banished to live at Huaishuo garrison.
units.literal: Hu had four sons; the third, Mi, served Wei, rose to Attending Censor, and for violating the law was exiled to garrison at Huaishuo.

units.zh: 嘗乘驛過建興，雲霧晝晦，雷聲隨之，半日乃絕，若有神應者。
units.en: Once while riding post through Jianxing, clouds and mist darkened the day and thunder rolled after him for half a day, as though heaven itself were answering his passage.
units.literal: Once riding post through Jianxing, clouds and mist darkened the day, thunder followed along, and for half a day it did not cease — as if there were a divine response.

units.zh: 為函使六年，每至洛陽，給令史麻祥使。
units.en: For six years as courier he went each time to Luoyang, where he was assigned to the clerk Ma Xiang.
units.literal: For six years as courier, whenever he reached Luoyang he was detailed to the clerk Ma Xiang.

units.zh: 及自洛陽還，傾產以結客。
units.en: On his return from Luoyang he poured out his fortune to gather followers.
units.literal: When he returned from Luoyang, he expended his whole estate to gather clients.

units.zh: 親故怪問之，答曰：「吾至洛陽，宿衛羽林相率焚領軍張彝宅，朝廷懼其亂而不問。
units.en: Kinsmen and friends asked what moved him; he answered, "At Luoyang I saw the Feathered Forest guards burn down the residence of Supreme Commander Zhang Yi in a mob, and the court, fearing worse trouble, never punished them.
units.literal: Relatives and friends wondered and asked him; he replied: "When I reached Luoyang, the palace guards of the Feathered Forest together burned the residence of the supreme commander Zhang Yi, and the court feared their disorder and did not inquire.

units.zh: 見一赤兔，每搏輒逸，遂至回澤。
units.en: They sighted a russet hare that bolted away whenever they closed, and the chase carried them to Huize Marsh.
units.literal: They saw a red hare; each time they closed in it escaped, and they went on as far as Huize Marsh.

units.zh: 澤中有茅屋，將奔入，有狗自屋中出，噬之，鷹兔俱死。
units.en: Near a hut on the marsh the hare was nearly inside when a dog rushed out, tore at it, and killed both hawk and hare.
units.literal: In the marsh there was a thatched hut; as the hare was about to flee into it, a dog came out from the hut and bit it, and hawk and hare both died.

units.zh: 鎮將遼西段長常奇神武貌，謂曰：「君有康濟才，終不徒然。」
units.en: Duan Chang of Liaoxi, the garrison commander, often admired Gao Huan's looks and told him, "You have the talent to heal the realm; you will not end your days obscurely."
units.literal: Duan Chang of Liaoxi, commander of the garrison, often marveled at Shenwu's appearance and said to him: "You possess talent for bringing order and succor; you will not in the end come to nothing."

units.zh: 便以子孫為托。
units.en: And he entrusted his descendants to Gao Huan's care.
units.literal: He thereupon entrusted him with his descendants.

units.zh: 與懷朔省事雲中司馬子如及秀容人劉貴、中山人賈顯智為奔走之友，懷朔戶曹史孫騰、外兵史侯景亦相友結。
units.en: He made running companions of Sima Ziru, affairs clerk at Huaishuo's Yunzhong desk, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan; Sun Teng, the garrison household clerk, and Hou Jing, clerk for external military affairs, joined their circle as well.
units.literal: With Sima Ziru, affairs clerk of Yunzhong at Huaishuo, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan he formed a band of comrades ready to run errands; Sun Teng, household clerk at Huaishuo, and Hou Jing, clerk in external military affairs, also joined in friendship.

units.zh: 劉貴嘗得一白鷹，與神武及尉景、蔡儁、子如、賈顯智等獵於沃野。
units.en: Liu Gui once came by a white hawk and went hunting on the open steppe with Gao Huan, Wei Jing, Cai Jun, Ziru, Jia Xianzhi, and the rest.
units.literal: Liu Gui once obtained a white hawk and hunted on the open fields with Shenwu, Jing, Cai Jun, Ziru, Jia Xianzhi, and others.

units.zh: 及神武生而皇妣韓氏殂，養於同產姊婿鎮獄隊尉景家。
units.en: When Gao Huan was born his mother Lady Han died, and he was reared in the household of his full elder sister's husband Wei Jing, captain of the garrison prison guard.
units.literal: When Shenwu was born the late mother Lady Han died, and he was raised in the home of his uterine elder sister's husband, Jing, captain of the garrison prison guard.

units.zh: 長而深沉有大度，輕財重士，為豪俠所宗。
units.en: As a man he was reserved and far-sighted, generous with money and devoted to worthy companions, and the local men of daring looked to him as their leader.
units.literal: When grown he was deep and reserved, possessed of great breadth of mind, lightly regarded wealth and valued men of talent, and was looked to by bold heroes.

units.zh: 目有精光，長頭高顴，齒白如玉，少有人傑表。
units.en: His eyes gleamed, his head was long and his cheekbones high, his teeth white as jade; even in youth he wore the bearing of a man marked for greatness.
units.literal: His eyes had a sharp brilliance; his head was long and cheeks high; his teeth white as jade — in youth he had the countenance of an uncommon man.

units.zh: 詳嘗以肉啖神武，神武性不立食，坐而進之。
units.en: Xiang once fed him meat; Gao Huan, who never ate standing, sat down to accept it.
units.literal: Xiang once offered meat to Shenwu to eat; Shenwu by nature would not eat standing, and so sat to receive it.

units.zh: 因自言善暗相，遍捫諸人皆貴，而指麾俱由神武。
units.en: Declaring herself skilled in reading fate by touch, she passed her hands over each man and pronounced them all destined for rank, yet said every fortune turned on Gao Huan.
units.literal: She then said herself that she was skilled at reading fortune by touch; she felt over everyone and found them all noble, yet all destinies depended on Shenwu's direction.

units.zh: 由是諸人益加敬異。
units.en: From that day his companions held him in still greater awe.
units.literal: From this the company all the more revered and marvelled at him.

units.zh: 為政若此，事可知也。
units.en: When government runs thus, the course of events is already clear.
units.literal: When government is like this, how affairs will turn out is plain to see.

units.zh: 財物豈可常守邪？」
units.en: What good is clinging to property forever?"
units.literal: Can wealth and goods be kept forever?"

units.zh: 又嘗夢履衆星而行，覺而內喜。
units.en: He also dreamed once that he walked treading upon the stars; when he woke he was secretly elated.
units.literal: Again he once dreamed of treading among the stars as he walked; waking, he rejoiced inwardly.

units.zh: 祥以為慢己，笞神武四十。
units.en: Xiang took this as an insult and had Gao Huan beaten forty strokes.
units.literal: Xiang took this as disrespect toward himself and had Shenwu flogged forty strokes.

units.zh: 神武怒，以鳴鏑射之，狗斃。
units.en: Gao Huan, furious, killed the dog with a whistling arrow.
units.literal: Shenwu in anger shot it with a whistling arrow and killed the dog.

units.zh: 飯竟出，行數里還，更訪之，則本無人居，乃向非人也。
units.en: After the meal they rode on, but a few li later turned back to find the place, and there was no hut at all—their hosts had not been of this world.
units.literal: When the meal was done they left; after going several li they turned back to visit again, but where there had been no dwelling at all — those before had not been human.

units.zh: 每行道路，往來無風塵之色。
units.en: Whenever he traveled the roads he seemed untouched by wind and dust.
units.literal: Whenever he traveled the roads, there was no look of wind and dust about his coming and going.

units.zh: 及貴，追贈長司空，擢其子寧用之。
units.en: After Gao Huan rose to power he posthumously honored Duan Chang with the title Minister of Works and brought his son Ning into office.
units.literal: When Shenwu rose high, he posthumously enfeoffed Chang as Minister of Works and promoted his son Ning to employment.

units.zh: 屋中有二人出，持神武襟甚急。
units.en: Two men burst from the hut and seized Gao Huan's robe in alarm.
units.literal: Two men came out from the hut and seized Shenwu's robe with great urgency.

units.zh: 和士開與祖珽譖之，云：「草人擬聖躬也。
units.en: He Shikai and Zu Ting slandered him, saying, "The straw effigy was modeled on the sacred person.
units.literal: He Shikai and Zu Ting slandered him, saying, "The straw effigy was modeled on the sacred person.

units.zh: 珽以說曰：「河南、河北，河間也。
units.en: Ting used this to explain, saying, "Henan and Hebei mean Hejian.
units.literal: Ting used this to explain, saying, "Henan and Hebei mean Hejian.

units.zh: 金雞鳴，孝琬將建金雞而大赦。」
units.en: The golden cock's crow means Xiaowan will build a golden cock and proclaim a great amnesty."
units.literal: The golden cock's crow means Xiaowan will build a golden cock and proclaim a great amnesty."

units.zh: 榮敗，隨尒朱榮，為別將討元顥，以功封敷城縣男。
units.en: When Rong was defeated he followed Erzhu Rong, served as a separate commander against Yuan Hao, and for merit was enfeoffed baron of Fucheng County.
units.literal: When Rong was defeated he followed Erzhu Rong, served as a separate commander against Yuan Hao, and for merit was enfeoffed Baron of Fucheng County.

units.zh: 遂奔葛榮，又亡歸尒朱榮於秀容。
units.en: He fled next to Ge Rong, then broke away again and took refuge with Erzhu Rong at Xiurong.
units.literal: He then fled to Ge Rong, and again broke away and returned to Erzhu Rong at Xiurong.

units.zh: 及尒朱榮擊葛榮，令神武喻下賊別稱王者七人。
units.en: When Erzhu Rong campaigned against Ge Rong, he sent Gao Huan to talk seven rebel kings into surrender.
units.literal: When Erzhu Rong attacked Ge Rong, he had Shenwu persuade seven bandit chiefs styling themselves kings to submit.

units.zh: 時穆子容為巡省使，嘆曰：「古人有言：『聞伯夷之風，貪夫廉，懦夫有立。』
units.en: At the time Mu Zirong was touring inspector; he sighed and said, "The ancients said: 'Hear the wind of Bo Yi, and the greedy grow honest; the timid stand firm.'
units.literal: At the time Mu Zirong was touring inspector; he sighed and said: "The ancients had a saying: 'When one hears the wind of Bo Yi, the greedy grow honest and the timid stand firm.'

units.zh: 李渾 子湛 渾弟繪 族子公緒 李璵 弟瑾 族弟曉 鄭述祖 子元德
units.en: Li Hun; his son Zhan; Hun's brother Hui; clansman Gongxu; Li Yu; brother Jin; clansman Xiao; Zheng Shuzu; son Yuande
units.literal: Li Hun; his son Zhan; Hun's brother Hui; clansman Gongxu; Li Yu; brother Jin; clansman Xiao; Zheng Shuzu; son Yuande

units.zh: 膺之弟子瑞，天保中為定州長史，遷吏部郎中。
units.en: Yingzhi's younger brother Zirui served as Chief Administrator of Ding Province during Tianbao and was transferred to Director in the Ministry of Personnel.
units.literal: Yingzhi's younger brother Zirui served as Chief Administrator of Ding Province during Tianbao and was transferred to Director in the Ministry of Personnel.

units.zh: 子瑞弟幼之，清貞有素行，少歷顯位。
